Suche Erweiterte Suche QA Engineer (Mid/Senior) ❮ zurück zur letzten Suche Talon.One Berlin 1000 per year Vollzeit BALDIGER BEWERBUNGSSCHLUSS Auf diesen Job bewerben ABOUT TALON.ONE: Talon.One is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, promotions and gamification into one holistic platform. Backed by enterprise-grade security and scalability, Talon.One empowers companies to build personalized, profitable promotions and loyalty programs using any data. Today, over 250 of the world’s most-loved brands including Adidas, Sephora and Carlsberg work with Talon.One to drive deeper engagement and lasting loyalty with their customers. ABOUT THE TEAM: Our Research and Development department is made up of cross-functional teams of Developers, Interaction Designers, QA Engineers, and Documentation specialists, all collaborating under the guidance of Product and Engineering Managers. Each team owns a specific area of our platform. We work with relative autonomy, encourage original ideas, foster professional growth, and believe that quality at every stage is of utmost importance. We’re looking for a QA Engineer who will be an advocate for quality from the very start of the development process. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with all functions to shape testing strategies, ask the right questions early, and ensure that robust test coverage exists as features are developed. Rather than merely focusing on testing completed changes, you’ll embed quality into our development process, championing best practices, improving test automation, and ensuring that great software is continuously delivered. ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL: Become an expert in the Talon.One product, and the foremost expert in the area for which your team is responsible. Collaborate with product, design, and engineering functions to ensure our delivered features are consistently of a high quality. Set the test strategy, engage critically with all functions from the outset of each feature. Ensure we have design and behavioral consistency between features, and strong, efficient test coverage at every level. Determine which test scenarios should be included in our suite of end-to-end automated tests, and implement those using Cypress. Willingness to proactively help junior Quality Engineers, provide timely feedback, and guide them to success. Contribute to Mentorship Programs and onboarding new joiners. WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE: Ability to communicate effectively and clearly in English, and precisely describe complex interactions Ability to architect a strong Test Strategy Strong track record in advocating for quality at all levels of development process 3 - 6+ years of experience delivering quality web applications with test automation, including REST APIs/GraphQL ABOUT TECHNOLOGY: Kubernetes running on Google Cloud PostgreSQL Golang for our API, core logic, and internal tooling TypeScript, React, Redux, and CSS modules for our web application Cypress for automated end-to-end testing WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: A Research and Development Department of 100+ of engineers, product managers and product designers in Berlin Leaders with 8+ years of experience building our promotions engine €1,000 annual learning budget and free German language courses to boost your skills 30 days of annual leave, plus extra paid days for your birthday and moving day Home office setup budget, a monthly home office allowance Freedom to work from abroad for up to 90 days worldwide! Mental health support with nilo.health and a discounted Urban Sports Club membership 20% company subsidy on your pension contributions BVG public transport ticket and welcome your furry friend in our dog-friendly Berlin office! cards.announcement: Senior Full Stack Developer - B2B platform (Laravel Nuxt/Vue) - adzuna.de Was? Wo? Suche Erweiterte Suche Senior Full Stack Developer - B2B platform (Laravel Nuxt/Vue) ❮ zurück zur letzten Suche ScholarshipOwl Deutschland, 10117 Unbefristet Vollzeit HOME-OFFICE Auf diesen Job bewerben About ScholarshipOwl ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation. We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered. The Role We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities. You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4 . Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Full Lifecycle Development: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end B2B features across the stack- from Laravel/Doctrine JSON:API endpoints to reactive Nuxt 3/4 Vue components and server routes. Embed & Analytics Engine: Develop and optimize high-performance embedded widget systems, Nitro server engine logic, iframe cross-origin messaging, client event-tracking SDKs, and data ingestion pipelines. API & Database Architecture: Design robust relational database schemas (MySQL), Doctrine entity mappings, clean migrations, performant RESTful/JSON:API contracts, and Redis caching layers. AI-Native Acceleration: Integrate AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) into daily development for rapid feature prototyping, code refactoring, test generation, and building LLM-driven product features (e.g., automated applicant evaluation). Third-Party Integrations *:* Integrate and maintain core third-party services and APIs, including CRM platforms, error tracking systems, payment gateways, and cloud data services Automated Testing & Quality: Establish comprehensive automated test coverage (PHPUnit for backend, Playwright and Vitest for E2E/components) integrated into CI/CD pipelines to guarantee zero regressions. Mentorship & Code Reviews: Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews and collaborate closely with product managers, QA engineers, and leadership to elevate team standards. Required Qualifications (Must Haves) Experience: 4+ years of professional full-stack web development experience, with at least 1+ year actively incorporating AI coding assistants into daily engineering workflows. Backend Expertise (PHP & Laravel): Strong commercial experience with PHP 8+ and Laravel (clean service architecture, queues/jobs, middleware, and OAuth2/Passport authentication). Frontend Mastery (Vue 3 & Nuxt 3/4): Deep proficiency in modern Vue 3 (Composition API), Nuxt 3 or Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Pinia state management, and Tailwind CSS. Database & ORM Skills: Strong relational database modeling and query optimization in MySQL, along with solid experience using ORMs (Doctrine ORM / DBAL or deep Eloquent experience with the ability to adapt to Doctrine quickly). API Design & Caching: Deep understanding of RESTful / JSON:API standards, server-side validation error mapping, request formatting, and Redis performance caching. AI-Native Workflow: Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) as a force multiplier for coding, debugging, and test creation. Automated Testing: Hands-on experience writing backend test suites (PHPUnit) and frontend/E2E tests (Playwright, Vitest, or Cypress). DevOps & Tooling: Solid working knowledge of Git, CI/CD release pipelines, Docker containerization, and Linux/container environments. Async Communication & Autonomy: Exceptional written technical communication skills for authoring PRs, architectural design docs, and issue tracking; high autonomy to navigate multi-service codebases, solve complex blockers independently, and drive initiatives. Good to Have Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience. Certifications *:* Advanced degree or formal certifications in Cloud Architecture, Modern Software Engineering, or AI Engineering. Doctrine ORM: Direct production experience with Doctrine ORM / DBAL in Laravel environments. Widget & SDK Systems: Experience developing embeddable web widgets, lightweight JavaScript tracking SDKs, iframe cross-origin communication, or browser fingerprinting. Modern Tooling: Experience with Nitro server engines, Bun runtime, PrimeVue components, or streaming data into data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery). Payment Gateways: Integration experience with payment processors (Stripe/Braintree) and B2B subscription billing lifecycles. Gemini LLM Integration: Practical experience integrating Google Gemini models (prompt engineering, structured JSON outputs, Gemini API / SDKs). Cloud Infrastructure (GCP): Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Kubernetes, Cloud Build). Bonus Skills (The "X-Factor") Technical Leadership: Prior experience in a Tech Lead or Team Lead capacity—driving architectural decisions, coordinating delivery, and unblocking team members. Domain Knowledge: Background in high-growth B2B SaaS platforms, grant/applicant management systems, EdTech, recruitment/ATS tools, or conversion tracking ecosystems. Product-Minded Execution: Strong product ownership mindset—evaluating engineering trade-offs through the lens of user experience, conversion funnel impact, and tangible business value. Why Join ScholarshipOwl? Mission-Driven Work: Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities and reduce financial barriers. Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world while collaborating with a global team. High Impact & Ownership: You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own your domain and directly drive results. Unlimited PTO: We value outcomes over hours worked and trust you to manage your time. Computer Upgrade Budget: Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal primary work computer. Workspace Upgrade Program: Up to $800 to set up your home office. Monthly Coworking Allowance: $200/month to rent desks or workspace passes whenever you want a change of scenery. Owl Shine Program: Monthly employee recognition and awards celebrating extraordinary contributions. Continuous Learning Culture: Dedicated support for curiosity, bold experimentation, and career growth. Annual Global Off-sites: Connect with your teammates in person at exciting locations around the world. Ready to lead and build something meaningful? Apply now and help us shape the future of AI-powered education.
